newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Breakdown of U.N. vote on nuclear test ban treaty.
newsitem.headline: Breakdown of U.N. vote on nuclear test ban treaty.

text.p: Following is the breakdown of the vote in the 185-member U.N. General Assembly on Tuesday on a resolution adopting a comprehensive nuclear test-ban treaty.
But the treaty must be ratified by 44 nations with a nuclear potential before it can enter into force. India, which is one of them, has said it would not do so.
The vote was 158 in favour, with three against (Bhutan, India and Libya) and five abstentions (Cuba, Lebanon, Mauritius, Syria and Tanzania).

Absent or not voting (19): Burundi, Central African Republic, Chad, Comoros, Dominican Republic, Equatorial Guinea, Eritrea, Gambia, Iraq, Lesotho, Mali, Niger, North Korea, Rwanda, Sao Tome and Principe, Seychelles, Somalia, Yugoslavia (suspended from U.N. Assembly) and Zambia.
